notes.title: Small Bug Fix.
notes.notes: Fixed the bug where the bald guy doesn't fall on the hole.

notes.title: Rooftop Postgirl got a New Release Date!
notes.notes: Hi, I'm going to release the full game on november 1st 2023 now!

notes.title: Rooftop Postgirl - New Character Movement!
notes.notes: Hi, I improved the way the player and other characters move in the game. Also, I fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Rooftop Postgirl - Now with Original Music!
notes.notes:
Hi, I've made some musics for the game. I don't know if they're better than the previous ones (I don't think so), but at least they're original.

I also fixed some small things such as translation errors.
